The recording is not a grasshopper; it's a cicada, Thopha saccata. I posted it here in the hope that Xeno-canto would be willing make some modifications that would to allow me to share some of my library of cicada calls through this platform. I am happy to modify this submission as required. Update: submission modified as per helpful instructions.
